title: M0 · Foundations and decisions
description: Repository, CI, benchmark and correctness harnesses, ratified design decisions, legal checks. Exit: a contributor can clone, build, test and re-run every lab number with one command.

title: M1 · De-risking lab, round 2
description: Time-boxed experiments on what the first lab left unsolved: out-of-core community detection, map hierarchy and edges, cost of determinism, memory bandwidth, non-social graphs, real-world inputs. Exit: each open risk has a number and a decision.

title: M2 · Format and ingest
description: The .eg container, the compressed adjacency codec, the I/O layer and the ingest pipeline. Exit: any CSV/Parquet edge list with integer, hex or string ids becomes a verified .eg file within the memory budget; Friendster in < 60 s at 8 GB.

title: M3 · Engine and kernels
description: Planner, memory accountant, edge-map framework over three execution regimes, and the core kernels. Exit: every kernel returns identical results in every regime and at every thread count, and never exceeds its budget.

title: M4 · Communities and hierarchy
description: Production Leiden (deterministic and fast modes), out-of-core operation, quality gates, and the map hierarchy. Exit: Friendster communities under a 16 GiB limit with modularity >= 0.60; quality within 1% of the best reference on six graph families.

title: M5 · The map
description: Layout, tile pyramid, .egmap format, WebGL2 viewer, static and live modes, Jupyter widget. Exit: a 1B-edge graph opens from a static URL with a first view under 250 KB and exact numbers at every zoom level.

title: M6 · Python and interop
description: The Python package, Arrow interoperability, import/export and the NetworkX backend. Exit: pip install on Linux/macOS/Windows, five tutorial notebooks, results flow zero-copy into Polars/pandas/DuckDB.

title: M7 · Queries and views
description: Point queries with budgets, shortest paths, filtered and temporal views, out-of-core query path, DuckDB integration. Exit: neighbors < 1.5 us p99 in RAM and < 0.3 ms cold; shortest path p50 < 2 ms in RAM on 10^9-arc graphs.

title: M8 · CLI, docs and v0.1 launch
description: Command-line tool, documentation, public benchmarks, three showcase maps, paper and release. Exit: v0.1.0 on PyPI and crates.io with reproducible benchmarks.

title: M9 · After v0.1
description: Browser tier, MCP server, query language, temporal segments, GPU layout, desktop app, sustainability. Not scheduled; ordered by expected value.
